title: PlannerBriefProjectRequest
description: Body of `POST /plans/from-brief` on `backlog-planner`, from `youtrack/planner/src/backlog_planner/domain/brief_project.py` (`parse_request`). Creates a tracker project and one epic per outcome from a Harvest brief the owner approved; the approval record stands in for the confirm step on this one call. Brief hash rule: the hash is sha256 over the revision record minus its own `hash` key, serialised as JSON with keys sorted at every level, compact separators (`,` and `:`) and non-ASCII characters left unescaped (Factory's `domain.digest`). The planner rehashes the record it receives that way and refuses the call (`brief_hash_mismatch`) when the result is not `approval.hash`; the schema states the rule and does not compute it. The planner also checks `approval.revision` equals `brief.number` and `approval.inputHash` equals `brief.inputHash`. No property carries a credential; the planner's tracker token never travels in this body.

projectKey.description: 2 to 10 characters: a letter, then letters, digits or `_`. The planner upper-cases it (stored form `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{1,9}$`).

projectName.description: Whitespace is collapsed by the planner.

model.description: The ai-gateway model id that derives the epics; must be in the gateway catalog (else `unknown_model`).

briefId.description: Optional; defaults to the first 12 characters of the approval hash.

revision.title: BriefRevisionRecord
revision.description: The approved Harvest revision record, sent WHOLE (Factory `harvest.py` `revision`). Every key beside `sections` is part of what was hashed, so none may be dropped or added. Brief hash rule: the hash is sha256 over the revision record minus its own `hash` key, serialised as JSON with keys sorted at every level, compact separators (`,` and `:`) and non-ASCII characters left unescaped (Factory's `domain.digest`). The planner rehashes the record it receives that way and refuses the call (`brief_hash_mismatch`) when the result is not `approval.hash`; the schema states the rule and does not compute it.

sections.description: Exactly the ten Harvest section keys, each 5 to 12000 characters (the planner also refuses a value shorter than 5 characters once trimmed).

risks.description: Optional. Risks the owner accepted when approving; unlike `blockers` they do not block approval. Absent is valid and such a brief hashes exactly as before. The planner rehashes the record as sent, so when `risks` is present it is part of the hash and must be sent unchanged.

at.description: ISO-8601 time the revision was made.

metadata.description: Draft provenance Factory records (requested model, model, provider, research note; `{}` for an owner-written revision). Bounded: at most 20 scalar values, no nested objects.

hash.description: The record's own digest. It is excluded when the planner rehashes.

approval.title: BriefApprovalRecord
approval.description: The owner's approval as Factory holds it. `actor` must be `owner`, otherwise the planner refuses with `actor_not_owner`.
